import datetime,hashlib,json,collections
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('survey/out');root=Path('docs/superpowers/specs');stem='2026-10-03-emergent-polarity-domestic'
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with Path(p).open('rb') as f:
  for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(block)
 return h.hexdigest()
prefix=[]
with (out/'polarity-domestic-findings.json').open() as f:
 for line in f:
  if line.startswith('  "raw_records": ['):
   prefix.append('  "raw_records": []\n}\n');break
  prefix.append(line)
 else:raise ValueError('Missing raw_records export boundary')
after=json.loads(''.join(prefix));before=json.loads((root/'2026-10-03-emergent-polarity-pre-domestic-findings.json').read_text());assembly=json.loads((out/'polarity-domestic-assembly-receipt.json').read_text());ids={a['id'] for a in assembly['per_arm']}
assert len(after['arms'])==572 and after['raw_record_count']==28520 and len(after['rows'])==863 and not after['global_issues'] and not after['unknown_arms']
assert all(a['received_sessions']==a['registered_sessions'] for a in after['arms'])
oldrows={r['id']:r for r in before['rows']};newrows={r['id']:r for r in after['rows']};assert oldrows.keys()==newrows.keys()
oldarms={a['id']:a for a in before['arms']};newarms={a['id']:a for a in after['arms']};assert oldarms.keys()==newarms.keys()
assert all(oldarms[a]==newarms[a] for a in oldarms if a not in ids)
assert before['stoermer']==after['stoermer']
aggregates=lambda r:[x for x in r['rows'] if x['id'].startswith(('defense/','alliance/','reported_source_direction/'))]
aggregate_rows_unchanged = aggregates(before)==aggregates(after)
changes=[{'id':k,'before':oldrows[k],'after':newrows[k]} for k in sorted(oldrows) if oldrows[k]!=newrows[k]]

All report dependencies recomputed using unchanged 18 functions, 100000 draws and seed2026100202; comparisons preserve every changed result and verdict.'}
(out/'polarity-domestic-before-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
summary={k:v for k,v in after.items() if k!='raw_records'};summary['domestic_amendment']=result;summary['execution_provenance']=json.loads((out/'polarity-domestic-provenance.json').read_text());summary['stock_diagnostics']=json.loads((out/'polarity-domestic-stock-diagnostics.json').read_text());summary['retained_pre_domestic_findings']='2026-10-03-emergent-polarity-pre-domestic-findings.json';summary['sequential_amendment']=before['sequential_amendment']

import datetime,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('survey/out');original=out/'polarity-telemetry-sessions.jsonl';corrected=out/'polarity-sequential-sessions.jsonl';destination=out/'polarity-final-sessions.jsonl'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def strict(s):return json.loads(s,parse_constant=lambda v:(_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(v)))
m=strict(Path('survey/polarity/studies.json').read_text());resolution=strict((out/'polarity-sequential-resolved.json').read_text());prior=strict((out/'polarity-telemetry-resolved.json').read_text());assert resolution==prior
cfg={a['id']:a['config'] for a in resolution['arms']};ids={a for a,c in cfg.items() if c['update']=='sequential'};assert len(ids)==16
retained_update_values=sorted({c['update'] for aid,c in cfg.items() if aid not in ids});assert retained_update_values==['snapshot']
expected={(a['id'],a['first_seed']+i) for a in m['arms'] for i in range(a['sessions'])};assert len(expected)==28520
expected_sequential={k for k in expected if k[0] in ids};assert len(expected_sequential)==320

def load(path,required):
 rows={};lines=[]
 for line in path.open('rb'):
  assert line.endswith(b'\n');r=strict(line);key=(r['arm'],r['seed']);assert key not in rows and key in required;assert r['manifest_sha256']==resolution['manifest_sha256'] and r['config']==cfg[key[0]];rows[key]=(r,line);lines.append(key)
 assert rows.keys()==required;return rows,lines
old,order=load(original,expected);new,_=load(corrected,expected_sequential)
valid={k:r for k,(r,line) in old.items() if k in expected_sequential and r['outcome']['valid']};assert len(valid)==83
mismatches=[k for k,r in valid.items() if new[k][0]!=r];assert not mismatches
def digest_valid(mapping):
 digest=hashlib.sha256()
 for key in sorted(valid):digest.update(json.dumps(mapping[key][0],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode()+b'\n')
 return digest.hexdigest()
assert digest_valid(old)==digest_valid(new)
oldpanics=[k for k in expected_sequential if old[k][0]['outcome']['finish_reason']=='panic'];assert len(oldpanics)==237
newpanics=[k for k,(r,line) in new.items() if r['outcome']['finish_reason']=='panic'];assert not newpanics
assert not destination.exists()
with destination.open('wb') as f:
 for key in order:f.write(new[key][1] if key in expected_sequential else old[key][1])
assembled,_=load(destination,expected)
unchanged_nonsequential=sum(assembled[k][1]==line for k,(r,line) in old.items() if k not in expected_sequential);assert unchanged_nonsequential==28200
result={'schema_version':1,'assembled_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'command':'python3 survey/out/polarity-assemble-final.py','assembly_script_sha256':sha(__file__),'assembly_script_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'assembly_rule':'Preserve original full record order and literal raw bytes for all 28,200 non-sequential records; replace every sequential record with same registered arm/seed record from corrected full 16-arm × 20-seed rerun. No replacements or selected failed-seed reruns.','manifest_sha256':sha('survey/polarity/studies.json'),'resolved_exact_file_sha256':sha(out/'polarity-sequential-resolved.json'),'original_full_sessions_sha256':sha(original),'corrected_sequential_sessions_sha256':sha(corrected),'assembled_sessions_sha256':sha(destination),'original_full_records':28520,'corrected_sequential_records':320,'assembled_records':28520,'unchanged_nonsequential_records':unchanged_nonsequential,'retained_nonsequential_arm_count':len(cfg)-len(ids),'retained_nonsequential_resolved_update_values':retained_update_values,'scope_proof':'Every one of the 28,200 retained raw records matches its unchanged authoritative resolved config; all 556 non-sequential arms resolve update=snapshot and cannot enter world.period dispatch to the sole changed sequential combat branch.','previously_valid_sequential_records':len(valid),'previously_valid_sequential_missing':0,'previously_valid_sequential_mismatches':mismatches,'previously_valid_sequential_mismatch_count':len(mismatches),'original_previously_valid_sequential_canonical_sha256':digest_valid(old),'corrected_previously_valid_sequential_canonical_sha256':digest_valid(new),'canonical_digest_method':'Sort original 83 previously valid keys by (arm, seed), include every complete outer field including stock_diagnostics, UTF-8 JSON sort_keys=True/separators comma-colon/allow_nan=False plus LF; SHA256.','original_sequential_panics':len(oldpanics),'corrected_sequential_panics':len(newpanics),'corrected_sequential_valid':sum(r['outcome']['valid'] for r,line in new.values()),'corrected_sequential_invalid':sum(not r['outcome']['valid'] for r,line in new.values()),'per_arm':[{'id':aid,'original_valid':sum(r['outcome']['valid'] for k,(r,line) in old.items() if k[0]==aid),'original_invalid':sum(not r['outcome']['valid'] for k,(r,line) in old.items() if k[0]==aid),'corrected_valid':sum(r['outcome']['valid'] for k,(r,line) in new.items() if k[0]==aid),'corrected_invalid':sum(not r['outcome']['valid'] for k,(r,line) in new.items() if k[0]==aid)} for aid in sorted(ids)]}
(out/'polarity-final-assembly-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='assembly_script_source'},indent=2))
